name: Keep the Beat
description: A co-op music game that mirrors gameplay into an Audiotool project.

AUDIOTOOL_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Public Audiotool OAuth client id, only to override the one compiled into the client. Not a secret.

AUDIOTOOL_REDIRECT_URI.description: Optional. The exact redirect URI registered at developer.audiotool.com, trailing slash included. Unset, the deployment's own root URL is used.

PUBLIC_HOST.description: Optional. The site's domain, which www. redirects to and sockets may come from. Defaults to keepthebeat.games.
